en.name: Andes Agri Systems Prize
en.description: A pre-launch startup competition for founders building crop intelligence, regenerative inputs, and climate-resilient farm systems for LATAM-China supply chains.
en.detailSubtitle: Designed for teams improving agricultural productivity, resilience, and traceability across cross-border food and materials corridors.
en.metaTitle: Andes Agri Systems Prize | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Explore the Andes Agri Systems Prize for AgriTech founders building resilient, climate-aware supply systems.
en.overviewHtml:
The Andes Agri Systems Prize highlights startups connecting farm productivity, traceability, and sustainability outcomes across Latin America and China.

The program is built for teams that can show practical deployment value in crops, inputs, or agri-infrastructure.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Startups building AgriTech, climate-smart farm systems, or resilient supply-chain tools.
  • Teams with a working product, pilot, or strong prototype.
  • Founders able to explain why a LATAM-China corridor strengthens their go-to-market path.
en.supportHtml:
• Visibility with operators, ecosystem partners, and innovation scouts.
  • Feedback on market-entry positioning and partner readiness.
  • Support preparing the final application narrative and materials.
en.processHtml:
1. Choose this competition in the shared form.
  2. Submit your product summary, traction, and supporting materials.
  3. Coordinate follow-up review with the LATAM China Tech team.

br.name: Andes Agri Systems Prize
br.description: Uma competicao pre-lancamento para startups que constroem inteligencia agricola, insumos regenerativos e sistemas resilientes para cadeias LATAM-China.
br.detailSubtitle: Feita para equipes que melhoram produtividade, resiliencia e rastreabilidade agricola entre America Latina e China.
br.metaTitle: Andes Agri Systems Prize | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Conheca o Andes Agri Systems Prize para founders de AgriTech focados em resiliencia climatica e cadeias sustentaveis.
br.overviewHtml:
O Andes Agri Systems Prize destaca startups que conectam produtividade agricola, rastreabilidade e sustentabilidade no corredor LATAM-China.

O programa foi pensado para equipes com valor real de implantacao em cultivos, insumos ou infraestrutura agricola.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Startups de AgriTech, sistemas climaticamente inteligentes ou ferramentas para cadeias resilientes.
  • Times com produto funcional, piloto ou prototipo forte.
  • Founders capazes de explicar por que o corredor LATAM-China acelera seu go-to-market.
br.supportHtml:
• Visibilidade com operadores, parceiros e scouts de inovacao.
  • Feedback sobre posicionamento e prontidao para parceiros.
  • Apoio para preparar narrativa e materiais da candidatura final.
br.processHtml:
1. Escolha esta competicao no formulario compartilhado.
  2. Envie resumo do produto, tracao e materiais de apoio.
  3. Coordene o follow-up com a equipe LATAM China Tech.

cn.category: 农业科技 · 可持续发展
cn.name: Andes Agri Systems Prize
cn.description: 面向构建作物智能、再生型投入品和气候韧性农业系统团队的预发布创业竞赛。
cn.detailSubtitle: 适合提升农业生产率、韧性与可追溯性的团队，目标市场覆盖拉美与中国之间的食品与原材料通道。
cn.metaTitle: Andes Agri Systems Prize | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 查看 Andes Agri Systems Prize，适合构建可持续农业系统与气候韧性解决方案的创业团队。
cn.overviewHtml:
Andes Agri Systems Prize 聚焦把农业生产力、可追溯性和可持续成果连接到中拉供应体系的创业团队。

项目面向能够在种植、投入品或农业基础设施中体现真实部署价值的方案。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 从事农业科技、气候智能农业系统或韧性供应链工具的创业公司。
  • 拥有产品、试点或强技术原型的团队。
  • 能够说明中拉通道为何会加强其市场进入路径的创始人。
cn.supportHtml:
• 面向运营方、生态伙伴和创新侦察方的曝光机会。
  • 关于市场定位和合作准备度的反馈。
  • 帮助整理最终申请叙事与提交材料。
cn.processHtml:
1. 在统一申请表中选择该竞赛。
  2. 提交产品摘要、牵引力说明和支持材料。
  3. 与 LATAM China Tech 团队协同完成后续审核。
